sections.heading: Who Can Join
sections.body: PTI is open to all youth above 14 years of age, male and female, regardless of academic background — school leavers and technical affiliates from industries and organisations. Learners with disabilities and other special needs are all welcome.

sections.heading: What Training Looks Like
sections.body: Trainees combine hands-on workshop, kitchen, lab, or farm-unit practice with theory, working on real production-unit jobs for the public and progressing toward Trade Test exams under DIT and UBTEB.

sections.heading: Our Core Values
sections.body: God Fearing, Discipline, Focused, Team Spirit, Passion — the values every trainee is expected to carry through training and into the workplace.
